component: Data Plane, Model Plane, and Inference Plane
summary: Threat model and attack class coverage manifest for the CVGuard Data Plane, Model Plane, and Inference Plane integrity assurance suite.

detectors.name: Near-Duplicate Perceptual Hash Detector
detectors.mechanism: 64-bit Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) Perceptual Hashing (pHash) with pairwise Hamming distance evaluation

covered_attack_classes.name: Exact and Near-Duplicate Image Injection
covered_attack_classes.description: Repeated submission of identical or near-identical images with minor compression, resizing, format conversion, or pixel shifts.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Flags pairs with Hamming distance <= 10; assigns high confidence to distance <= 2.

covered_attack_classes.name: Dataset Flooding / Redundant Sample Bias
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary or automated scraper injecting repetitive duplicate data to skew training class distribution.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Sample-level QUARANTINE disposition for distance <= 1; feeds sample signals into SourceAggregator.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Large Spatial Transformations and Non-Affine Crops
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: 64-bit DCT perceptual hash is sensitive to large rotations (>15-30 degrees) and heavy random cropping.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Semantic-Only Duplicates with Distinct Visual Surface Rendering
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Does not model high-level semantic equivalence if visual rendering geometry or background varies significantly.

detectors.name: Out-of-Distribution Mahalanobis Detector
detectors.mechanism: Dense visual feature embeddings via self-hosted ONNX vision backbone and regularized empirical covariance precision matrices

covered_attack_classes.name: Covariate Shift and Out-of-Domain Contamination
covered_attack_classes.description: Inclusion of foreign, out-of-domain, or non-target category images into a labeled training partition.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Measures Mahalanobis distance against registered class centroid and precision matrix; confidence scales with distance beyond boundary.

covered_attack_classes.name: Coarse Out-of-Distribution Poisoning
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary attempting to inject irrelevant imagery under legitimate class headings.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Flags samples with distance > calibrated threshold (default 12.0) with REVIEW disposition.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Adversarial Embedding Invariance (Manifold-Constrained Perturbations)
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Adversarial perturbations mathematically constrained to remain within the class reference covariance ellipsoid will evade Mahalanobis detection.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Multimodal Semantic Sub-Distributions
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Unimodal Gaussian assumption may yield elevated false positive rates on classes with wide diversity (e.g. vehicle types) without Gaussian Mixture Modeling.

detectors.name: Label-Flip and Systematic Mislabelling Detector
detectors.mechanism: k-Nearest-Neighbor (kNN) consensus analysis in normalized feature representation space

covered_attack_classes.name: Sparse and Systematic Label Flipping
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary maliciously re-annotating images with incorrect target labels to degrade classification boundaries or poison model accuracy.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Evaluates consensus among k (default 10) nearest semantic neighbors; flags discordance >= 70%.

covered_attack_classes.name: Human Annotator Fatigue / Systematic Label Drift
covered_attack_classes.description: Unintentional annotation errors where annotators consistently misclassify visually distinct classes.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Emits confidence proportional to neighborhood discordance with evidence detailing the dominant consensus class.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Symmetric 100% Class Swapping (Coordinated Global Inversion)
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: If an entire class is 100% swapped with another, the nearest neighbors will also possess the swapped label, evading majority consensus checks.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Fine-Grained Borderline Visual Ambiguity
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Legitimate borderline samples near true decision boundaries (e.g. Siberian Husky vs Alaskan Malamute) may exhibit neighborhood discordance.

detectors.name: Frequency-Domain FFT Spectral Trigger Detector
detectors.mechanism: 2D Fast Fourier Transform high-frequency power spectrum outlier analysis and inverse-FFT spatial saliency localization

covered_attack_classes.name: High-Frequency Backdoor Injection (Checkerboards / Grids)
covered_attack_classes.description: Backdoor triggers composed of sharp high-frequency spatial artifacts (e.g. BadNets checkerboard patterns, static noise patches, crosshairs).
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Identifies statistical outliers (z-score >= 2.5) in high-frequency energy ratio; localizes trigger bounding box as evidence.

covered_attack_classes.name: Periodic Watermark / Steganographic Trigger Artifacts
covered_attack_classes.description: Injected synthetic spectral spikes used to watermark or poison vision models.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Emits cautious confidence (capped at 0.70) with strict REVIEW disposition.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Clean-Label Natural Trigger Blends (Low-Frequency Watermarks)
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Triggers blended smoothly into natural imagery using low-frequency spectral filters or subtle global illumination shifts do not generate high-frequency spikes.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Semantic Physical Object Backdoors
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Natural physical objects acting as triggers (e.g. sunglasses, yellow sticky notes, coffee cups) have standard natural scene power spectra.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Feature Collision / Imperceptible Warping Backdoors
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: WaNet-style elastic image deformations or Wan/Sheng-style gradient-optimized clean-label poisons evade frequency magnitude thresholding.

detectors.name: Unified Cross-Detector Source Aggregator
detectors.mechanism: Weighted multi-signal contributor anomaly scoring and population z-score normalization

covered_attack_classes.name: Multi-Vector Coordinated Contributor Poisoning
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary contributing multiple weak or diverse anomalies (e.g. one OOD image + one mislabeled image) that individually seem borderline but collectively indicate malicious intent.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Combines weighted scores across all active detectors; flags contributor with AssetType.SOURCE finding when cumulative z-score >= 1.5 and anomaly count >= 2.

covered_attack_classes.name: Source Contamination Concentration
covered_attack_classes.description: Single vendor, hardware device, or data collector experiencing systematic calibration corruption across multiple modalities.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Provides clear evidence tracking all affected sample keys and active detector channels for audit quarantine.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Sybil Identity Rotation Across Ingest Windows
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: An adversary rotating disposable contributor identifiers on every image submission evades batch-local source grouping without cross-batch identity correlation.

detectors.name: Sandboxed Model Checkpoint Loader and Serialization Verifier
detectors.mechanism: POSIX/gVisor isolated container subprocess boundary, magic byte verification, raw pickle blocking, and hard resource caps (RLIMIT_AS, RLIMIT_CPU, wall-clock timeout)

covered_attack_classes.name: Arbitrary Code Execution via Deserialization Exploits
covered_attack_classes.description: Hostile model files containing Python pickle __reduce__ exploit payloads or executable native code attempting host compromise.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Blocks raw pickles; enforces torch.jit.load with weights_only=True fallback; executes all loading in isolated, network-isolated child process.

covered_attack_classes.name: Denial-of-Service via Computational Hangs and Memory Exhaustion
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary uploading infinite-loop graphs or multi-gigabyte allocation bombs to crash the model evaluation service.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Enforces 1GB address-space limits (SIGSEGV/OOM interception), 15s CPU limit (SIGXCPU), and 20s wall-clock timeout with process group SIGKILL.

covered_attack_classes.name: Archive Header Zip-Slip Directory Traversal
covered_attack_classes.description: Crafted TorchScript zip archives containing relative path escapes ('../') targeting host filesystem overwrite.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Pre-flight archive header inspection rejects any archive entry with parent directory escapes or absolute paths.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Zero-Day Host Kernel Exploits Under Stand-in Subprocess Sandbox
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Before upgrading to hardware-enforced gVisor (runsc) or Firecracker microVMs in production, process-level isolation shares the host kernel.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Hardware Microarchitectural Side Channels
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Does not protect against Spectre/Meltdown CPU cache timing attacks across shared cores.

detectors.name: White-Box Weight & Parameter Statistical Fingerprint Detector
detectors.mechanism: Layer-wise parameter distribution moment analysis (mean, standard deviation, L2 norm, and sparsity) against declared architecture envelopes

covered_attack_classes.name: Coarse Weight Tampering and Backdoor Weight Spikes
covered_attack_classes.description: Tampered neural network weights modified with massive weight scaling or abnormal norm spikes to force dominant trigger routing.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Flags layers exceeding expected L2 norm ceilings or standard deviation bounds for the declared architecture.

covered_attack_classes.name: Numerical Denial of Service via NaN and Inf Weight Poisoning
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary injecting NaN or Infinity values into weights to cause silent downstream inference breakdown.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Full tensor scan for NaN/Inf values; generates CRITICAL severity finding with QUARANTINE disposition.

covered_attack_classes.name: Extreme Layer Sparing and Pruning Tampering
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary zeroing out critical convolutional filters or attention heads.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Monitors per-layer zero sparsity against architecture-specific thresholds.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Manifold-Constrained / Clean-Weight Backdoors
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Subtle, gradient-regularized backdoor insertions (e.g. TrojNN or clean-label attacks) that maintain natural layer-wide statistical moments evade moment-based fingerprinting.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Architectural Trigger Mechanisms Unavailable in Black-Box Mode
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Detector is strictly skipped when only query access is provided (cannot inspect weights without white-box access).

detectors.name: White-Box Penultimate Activation Clustering Detector
detectors.mechanism: KMeans (k=2) sub-clustering and silhouette separation analysis on penultimate-layer feature representations of probe samples

covered_attack_classes.name: Targeted Backdoor Poisoning with Latent Feature Segregation
covered_attack_classes.description: Backdoored vision models where triggered samples activate a distinct latent cluster compared to legitimate class samples.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Per-class KMeans k=2 clustering flags classes exhibiting high inter-cluster separation (ratio >= 2.2) and a 5%-40% minority sub-cluster.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Backdoors Requiring Unrepresented Trigger Mechanisms in Probe Set
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Activation clustering assumes access to a labeled probe set representative of training classes; triggers unrepresented in the probe set do not activate latent sub-clusters.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Legitimate Multimodal Semantic Sub-Classes
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Broad semantic categories with distinct visual subclasses (e.g., convertibles vs vans in 'automobile') can trigger benign sub-cluster separation.

detectors.name: Black-Box STRIP (STRong Intentional Perturbation) Backdoor Detector
detectors.mechanism: Output prediction Shannon entropy evaluation across intentional input superposition blending perturbations

covered_attack_classes.name: Dominant Trigger-Driven Backdoors
covered_attack_classes.description: Models compromised with high-confidence backdoor triggers where the trigger overrides input perturbations and persistently predicts the target class.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Superimposes probe images with random backgrounds; flags inputs whose prediction entropy drops below 0.45 bits.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Backdoors Requiring Architectural Trigger Mechanisms Unavailable in Black-Box Mode
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Pure query-only mode cannot inspect weight tensors or internal activation maps.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Dynamic and Composite Backdoors
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Triggers that depend on exact spatial positioning or multiple simultaneous conditions may deactivate under heavy image superposition.

detectors.name: Canonical Reference Battery Behavioral Envelope Detector
detectors.mechanism: Fixed, versioned canonical vision reference battery running against model outputs to evaluate prediction confidence and entropy envelopes

covered_attack_classes.name: Severe Model Degradation and Class Fixation
covered_attack_classes.description: Broken, corrupted, or malicious models that output constant predictions, inverted classes, or zero confidence across standard visual inputs.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Compares output probabilities against documented min/max confidence and entropy bounds for 5 canonical vision probes.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Task-Divergent Domain Models
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Specialized models trained on custom medical, satellite, or non-classification tasks will not match canonical general vision envelopes.

detectors.name: Database-Enforced Atomic Monotonic Sequence Allocator
detectors.mechanism: PostgreSQL row-level locking and unique constraint (model_id, sequence_number) on append transactions

covered_attack_classes.name: Inference Request Replay and Sequence Duplication
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary re-submitting previously observed inference payloads or forging sequence numbers to duplicate transactions.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Strict atomic increment (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) and database UNIQUE constraint rejects replayed sequence numbers with HTTP 409 Conflict.

covered_attack_classes.name: Out-of-Order Execution and Gap Injection
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary reordering requests or injecting gaps to invalidate temporal provenance or hide malicious queries.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Enforces contiguous monotonic sequence numbers per registered model identity.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Pre-Network Client Interception Prior to Ingress
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Sequence numbers protect against post-ingress replay; unauthorized requests generated prior to network ingress require client mTLS or application auth tokens.

detectors.name: Cryptographic Inference Tuple Binding Verifier
detectors.mechanism: Canonical JSON serialization and SHA-256 digest over (sequence_number, model_id, input_hash, config_hash, output_hash)

covered_attack_classes.name: Post-Hoc Output Substitution / Label Tampering
covered_attack_classes.description: Attacker modifying inference predictions or confidence scores after execution to disguise model failures.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Recomputing canonical record binding digest immediately exposes any discrepancy between stored and computed values.

covered_attack_classes.name: Input Image Substitution and Model Weight Swapping
covered_attack_classes.description: Claiming an inference prediction belongs to a different input image or an approved baseline model checkpoint.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Cryptographic binding ties raw input SHA-256 and model weight identifier into the immutable leaf hash.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Physical Sensor and Lens Spoofing Prior to Digitization
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Cryptographic binding guarantees digital provenance of acquired bytes, not physical authenticity of the photons captured.

detectors.name: Cryptographic Merkle Batch Aggregator & Governance Sealer
detectors.mechanism: Bottom-up binary Merkle tree aggregation over record binding hashes, sealed with Ed25519 signatures in the Governance Spine

covered_attack_classes.name: Batch Truncation and Selective Record Deletion
covered_attack_classes.description: Adversary attempting to erase incriminating inference queries from audit logs.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Individual inference records are bound to batch Merkle roots sealed in the immutable, hash-chained governance ledger.

covered_attack_classes.name: Audit Proof Forgery
covered_attack_classes.description: Fabricating proof paths for records not executed in the reported batch.
covered_attack_classes.mitigation: Merkle proof verification mathematically guarantees inclusion under the signed root; tampered proofs fail verification.

uncovered_attack_classes.name: Side-Channel Information Leakage During Execution
uncovered_attack_classes.reason: Batch sealing guarantees integrity and non-repudiation of outputs, but does not prevent hardware side-channel observation (e.g. power analysis, cache timing).
